cards.name: Troweled Dash Stucco
cards.summary: Substance 3D material for Illustrator's 3D and Materials effect. Its shipped preview (a sphere, file image, not a script render) shows warm sand-beige plaster with a rough dashed, pebbly texture, flatter trowelled patches and dark pitted crevices. Inputs: Plaster Color, Plaster Roughness, Plaster Density, Dirt Spread, Dirt Color; presets Slightly Aged Stucco, Dirty Stucco, Clean Stucco.
use_for: rustic or Mediterranean wall surface on a 3D sign or lettering
earthy textured packaging mock-up
architectural or interior-themed 3D icon
warm, handmade-feel 3D headline
avoid: flat 2D print art: the texture only shows on a 3D and Materials object; use a pattern fill or texture image instead
small icons: the dash texture turns to noise at small sizes
clean modern or glossy looks: it is matte and dirty by default (the Clean Stucco preset softens it)
cards.applies_to: a vector object (or group / text) that has a 3D and Materials effect; the material maps onto its 3D surface
cards.how_to_apply: Panel only: select the object, Effect > 3D and Materials > Extrude / Revolve / Inflate (or Plane), open the Materials tab, pick it under Adobe Substance Materials, then edit its inputs in Properties. No scripting call was harvested (invoke holds only the .sbsar file: C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe Illustrator 2026/Support Files/Contents/Windows/Material-Resources/Default_Substance_Materials/troweled_dash_stucco.sbsar).

verified.note: Shipped sphere preview: warm sand-beige plaster with a rough pebbly dash texture, smoother trowelled patches and dark pitted crevices, matte.

cards.name: Apply Default Style (selection)

with nothing selected: it needs a selection
